newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi says agreed with U.S. on further bomb probe.
newsitem.headline: Saudi says agreed with U.S. on further bomb probe.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Defence Minister Prince Sultan was quoted on Monday as saying he has agreed with U.S. officials on the need to continue investigating the June bombing that killed 19 U.S. servicemen in the kingdom.

"There was an evaluation of the measures and investigation by security authorities in the kingdom and it was agreed with the American side that it was important to continue the investigation," he told the Saudi-owned London-based Asharq al-Awsat newspaper.

U.S. officials had said after Prince Sultan's visit to Washington last month that Saudi Arabia renewed pledges to cooperate in the investigation of the truck bombing in the eastern town of Khobar. Washington had complained Saudi Arabia was not sharing enough information.
Prince Sultan said last month his government was making progress, but added the probe would not be rushed.
